text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 3) 2021.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh mulai 6 Mei 2021 hingga 20 Mei 2021.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Cili merah

2. Sawi hijau

3. Tomato

4. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

5. Terung panjang

6. Timun

7. Halia tua

8. Ikan demuduk, sagai, cermin atau cupak (anggaran berat antara 3 ekor

hingga 5 ekor sekilogram)

9. Ikan kembung segar beku (anggaran berat antara 8 ekor hingga 10 ekor

sekilogram)

10. Ikan selar segar beku (anggaran berat antara 8 ekor hingga 10 ekor

sekilogram)

11. Ikan selayang bulat segar beku (anggaran berat antara 12 ekor hingga

14 ekor sekilogram)

Dibuat 30 April 2021

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XII]

 DATO SRI ALEXANDER NANTA LINGGI

 Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 3) ORDER 2021

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 3) Order 2021.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles

for the period from 6 May 2021 to 20 May 2021.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Red chilli

2. Green mustard

3. Tomato

4. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including

Beijing cabbage)

5. Long eggplant

6. Cucumber

7. Old ginger

8. Malabar trevally (weight estimation ranges between 3 fishes to 5 fishes

per kilogram)

9. Frozen fresh Indian mackerel (weight estimation ranges between 8 fishes

to 10 fishes per kilogram)

10. Frozen fresh yellow scad fish (weight estimation ranges between 8 fishes

to 10 fishes per kilogram)

11. Frozen fresh round scad fish (weight estimation ranges between 12 fishes

to 14 fishes per kilogram)
